verdict.rationale: Trello's own site makes a first-party claim that you can 'Automate tasks and workflows with Trello'. That is the story's capability, but it is backed only by a single marketing line. The Power-Up and webhook material is developer building blocks and earns no credit. missing for 10: documentation of a trigger-and-action rule builder (triggers, actions, conditions), details of how rules are configured and run, any limits or plan restrictions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can build trigger-and-action automation rules to eliminate repetitive manual steps

citations.quote: Automate tasks and workflows with Trello.
